title: Unit Event — Rise and Strive — Episode2 What's Important

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku's commercial appearance made waves, and job offers for MORE MORE JUMP! are starting to trickle back in. At the same time, it's still unclear what caused the dry spell they experienced. Haruka steels herself and sets up a meeting with someone who may have an idea...

rows.Line: Hotel Cafe

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I haven't talked to Mr. Hiiragi since Idol Lovers...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm a little nervous about asking him for advice since he's the producer of our rival group...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I have to try every lead that I can right now...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi's Voice
rows.Line: Kiritani.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's been a while, Mr. Hiiragi.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I apologize for making you wait.
My previous engagement took longer than expected.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I should be the one apologizing for asking you to meet on such short notice. I know you're very busy, so thank you for making the time to meet with me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The last time we spoke was at Idol Lovers, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Thank you for collaborating with my group that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, our group should be thanking you.
We learned so much by watching ReLight.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They were the reason why we were able to perform at a higher level than normal that day.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I see...
Yes, your group did put on a remarkable performance that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm really glad you're saying that, Mr. Hiiragi.
But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Something strange has happened since Idol Lovers... I'm here to talk to you about that today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is, for a time after that event, we stopped receiving offers for work altogether...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've slowly begun receiving offers again recently, but it's nothing compared to what we were getting before Idol Lovers...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, we understand that it might've simply been an unlucky period for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But... It happened so suddenly.
We think there must have been a reason, and we're trying to figure that out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I know this is our group's problem.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I thought you would know something, Mr. Hiiragi, since you have your finger on the pulse of the industry. That's why I asked you to meet with me today.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, so... If you do happen to know of any rumors surrounding us, then would you mind telling me?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I'm sorry to disappoint you, but...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I can't say I have heard anything.
I'm not sure I can help you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What if there's no root cause? We might be on a wild goose chase here...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But based on what the other people who I've talked to have said—)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Doesn't your group employ staff?
Don't you have anyone to take care of these things?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: It just seems strange that a member of your group would take it upon herself to go out and investigate.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... Yes, we do have a manager.
For the most part, she takes care of all the scheduling and such.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: So, you don't have someone running the show behind the scenes...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We generally come up with ideas for streams and plans for our appearances as a group.
That being said...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've been asked to be the producer for our group.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: You?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
I know I'm an amateur compared to you, Mr. Hiiragi...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I see. That's certainly a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. I was also surprised.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Especially since I once gave up on being an idol altogether when I was a member of ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I later decided that I wanted to keep spreading hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That happened when I met the other members of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I plan on doing everything I can for my group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I want to lead us down the right path.
Just like you did with ASRUN, Mr. Hiiragi.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel...
But again, I'm sorry. I don't think I can help you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Thank you for taking the time to talk with me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If Mr. Hiiragi doesn't know anything, then I guess that means Airi was right. We may've just been on a lucky streak before now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, but...
Can I ask you one thing before you go?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If a group you were responsible for found itself in a situation like MORE MORE JUMP! is in now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If they weren't receiving any offers for unknown reasons, and you weren't certain whether things would ever go back to normal...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What would you do, Mr. Hiiragi?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Regardless of the situation, I wouldn't act differently.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I'd stick to my principles and keep moving forward. I'd continue to believe that they'd eventually break out of that situation.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Above all else, I would never lose sight of my goals.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to ramble on.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
But I need to get going.
If you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Of course...
Thank you again for taking time out of your busy schedule to meet with me today.
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Never lose sight of your goals”...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I remember being told the same thing when I was still in ASRUN.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (When you're trying to achieve something, those around you will say what they want. You might even get hung up on their words from time to time. But...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (You can never lose sight of your goals.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mr. Hiiragi hasn't changed at all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(And he's right...
We need to keep our eyes on the prize.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which means we have to do what we can right now.)
